title: Shell Stitch
description: Create a soft fan shape by grouping stitches into the same space.

content.summary: A shell is usually several tall stitches worked into one stitch or chain space, followed by a skip or anchor stitch.
content.whyItMatters: Shell stitch introduces grouped stitch logic and teaches you to read repeated decorative shapes.
steps: Identify the stitch or space where the shell belongs.
Work the required number of tall stitches into that same spot.
Count the full shell before moving on.
Skip or anchor stitches exactly as the pattern says.
Repeat the shell spacing rhythm across the row.
content.practice: Work a short swatch with 3-shell repeats so you can see the fan shape open up.
commonMistakes: Losing count inside the shell and making it uneven.
Skipping the wrong number of stitches between shells.
